Module A: The Company DNA.Founding Story: Allstate was founded on April 17, 1931, by Sears, Roebuck and Co. [2, 4, 6, 7]. The initial concept was direct-mail auto insurance, proposed by insurance broker Carl L. Odell to Sears President Robert E. Wood, aiming to reduce costs by eliminating agent commissions [4, 6, 7]. The first policy insured a 1930 Studebaker for $41.60 [2, 4]. The name 'Allstate' was chosen from a contest among Sears employees and was previously a Sears tire brand [4, 7].
